verdict.rationale: Snyk documents its own bulk capabilities. The Snyk API & Web CLI runs operations on targets, scans and findings in bulk by identifiers or filter. The Remediation Agent's /snyk-batch-fix addresses multiple issues at once. The CLI's --all-projects flag tests and monitors many packages together. However, bulk support is documented only for these specific surfaces, not across the platform as a whole. missing for 10: platform-wide bulk operations (e.g., bulk ignore/triage or bulk project and org management in the main Snyk product), detailed docs on limits and scope of bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can run operations on your targets, scans, and findings one by one or in bulk by providing the identifiers or applying a filter.
Use `/snyk-batch-fix` to address multiple issues at once.
use the `--all-projects` flag to test and monitor your packages
